symptoms: Chronic tiredness, reduced concentration, irritability
remedy: Preventive approach: Ashwagandha (adaptogen with RCT evidence). Regular sleep schedule. Balanced nutrition. WHO recommends addressing underlying psychosocial stressors.

symptoms: Nicotine cravings, irritability, anxiety, weight gain
remedy: Preventive approach: WHO MPOWER framework. Cochrane: NRT (gum/patch) doubles quit rates. Cytisine (natural alkaloid, cost-effective). Behavioral counseling.

symptoms: Nasal congestion, sore throat, mild cough, sneezing
remedy: Chronic management: Saline nasal irrigation (Cochrane-supported), zinc lozenges within 24h of symptom onset, vitamin C supplementation, adequate fluid intake.

symptoms: Rapid breathing, chest indrawing, fever, cough

symptoms: Persistent cough lasting >8 weeks, throat clearing

symptoms: High fever, body aches, headache, fatigue, cough
remedy: Chronic management: WHO recommends rest, hydration, antipyretics. Traditional elderberry syrup shows modest antiviral effect in Cochrane-reviewed trials.

symptoms: Watery stools, dehydration, abdominal cramps
remedy: Chronic management: WHO-ORS formula: 1L water + 6 tsp sugar + 0.5 tsp salt. Cochrane review confirms ORS reduces mortality by >90% in acute diarrheal disease. Zinc supplementation for 10-14 days in children.
